text: Git branching is a key skill for modern software development. A branch lets you work on new features without affecting the main codebase. Developers create feature branches to add new functionality safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Many teams use pull requests so others can review changes before merging. This creates a clear version control workflow where everyone can see what changed and why. Branches keep work organised, reduce mistakes, and make teamwork easier. Learning how to use branches well will help you collaborate more effectively on any coding project.
